title: Software Fairness Debt
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper does not conduct a benchmark measurement related to faith or religion.
findings: The paper does not analyze any aspects related to religion or faith. Its focus is on software fairness concerning characteristics such as race, gender, ethnicity, socioeconomic status, age, and LGBTQIA+ identity.
